## ​ Prompts to try

Check Account balances

> Show me the Accounts and balances in [Workspace name], grouped by currency. Flag any unavailable balances.

Review recent activity

> Show me the Transactions in [Workspace name] from the last 3 days, with the Account, counterparty, amount, and status.

Review outgoing Payments

> Summarize completed outgoing payment Transactions in [Workspace name] from yesterday, excluding internal Transfers. Keep currencies separate and tell me if any results or amounts are missing.

Review your own card activity

> Show me my card purchases and refunds in [Workspace name] this week. Tell me whether the results cover only my cards or the whole Workspace.

Export a transaction statement

> Export last month’s transaction statement for [Workspace name] as CSV. Check which dates and Accounts are available, then download the file when it is ready.
